label: Form
blurb: Ask for structured answers: sliders, choices, text.

intro.doc: one line of context above the fields

fields.doc: each { id, type: range|select|checkbox|text|textarea, label, value, … }

controls.label: Reset answers
controls.doc: Clear every answer back to its neutral default (a range to its own minimum, a select to its first option, everything else to empty/false), after a confirmation drawn in the page.

notes: Field ids stay SEMANTIC and author-chosen — you read answers back by them.
A default value may mean "not answered yet".
